title: Programming as a puzzle
summary: Third part of NH's conceptual programming trifecta (with the pot of recovery and the specificity tree), framing programming as a puzzle of interlocking pieces. Captions are unusable machine-translated junk, so this note relies on the title and description: programming is mandatory for naturals pushing their limits, and it is easier than people think.
claims: Programming is best thought of as a puzzle whose pieces (volume, intensity, frequency, recovery, exercise selection) must fit together
Programming isn't optional; it is mandatory for anyone who wants to push the limits of their body naturally
Contrary to popular belief, programming is easy, so lifters should try to program for themselves
The pot of recovery, the specificity tree and programming as a puzzle form a three-part conceptual framework
